name: What should I ask a designer before starting a home addition in Pasadena?

mainEntity.name: What questions should I ask before hiring someone to design my addition?
mainEntity.text: What questions should I ask before hiring someone to design my addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before hiring a designer, ask how they approach site constraints, setbacks, roof tie-ins, and permitting in your city. You also want to know whether they provide concept plans only or manage engineering, permitting, and construction documents too. Ask for examples of additions on homes similar to yours, especially if your property has narrow setbacks, hillside conditions, or an older structure. Make sure the designer can explain budget impacts early, because layout choices can change cost dramatically. It is also smart to ask how many revision rounds are included, who coordinates consultants, and how the team handles unexpected structural issues once walls are opened. In Pasadena and nearby areas, local code familiarity can save time and reduce redesigns. A strong designer should be able to show how the addition will connect to the existing house, where natural light will come from, and how the new space will stay functional over time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask about structural feasibility, permit strategy, local code experience, design timeline, budget range, and how the team handles revisions. Also ask whether they will coordinate engineering, selections, and city approvals. The best designer can explain how the addition will fit the existing home before drawings are finalized.
